emma (Product): Quick design huddle: finalizing Playground streaming controls. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/playground-streaming. Need decisions on: visual streaming affordance (append vs shimmer), primary button label (Stop / Interrupt / Cancel), token counter placement (inline vs floating pill), and prompt library behavior mid-run. Thoughts?

li (Frontend): Prefer append buffer (new chunks layer then crossfade) to avoid big layout shifts. Floating token pill on the right rail solves counter jumping.

sanjay (Eng): Append buffer works with current SSE flow. Note: we cancel server-side on user stop, no resume. So avoid "Pause" label. "Stop generation" is clear; "Interrupt" is shorter but slightly technical.

rosa (Accessibility): If we pick "Stop generation", button aria-label should be explicit: aria-label="Stop generation, partial response may be returned". Streaming chunks: use aria-live="polite" and coalesce updates (e.g., every 300ms) so screen readers aren't flooded. Token pill needs aria-describedby for tooltip text.

paul (PM): Users confuse Stop vs Cancel. My vote is "Stop generation" visible + tooltip: "Stops generation. Partial response may be returned. Use Regenerate to try again." Keeps label friendly.

li (Frontend): Implementation notes: token pill compact while streaming (count + indeterminate ring), expands after finish to show breakdown (prompt/response/total). Debounce updates to 200ms. Make pill focusable and add small tooltip: "Counts may update after stop."

sanjay (Eng): Edge case: interrupt sometimes triggers fallback model which can change token counts after finalization. We'll emit a final token summary; frontend should animate delta and show a short microcopy: "Counts updated after stop."

rosa (Accessibility): For the token delta, announce with text like: "Token count updated to 412 (changed by +12)" via aria-live once. Also ensure stop button is first in tab order so keyboard users can interrupt quickly.

emma (Product): Prompt library: allow browsing mid-stream but disable "Apply" actions with caption "Applies to next run". Keep it keyboard accessible. If user chooses a template, show a small "Pending: <name>" badge in the rail.

li (Frontend): Will prototype append buffer + floating pill + pending badge. Keyboard shortcut idea: press I to stop generation (show hint in tooltip).

paul (PM): Action items: li prototype by EOD Fri, rosa to review A11y strings once prototype is ready, sanjay to confirm cancel semantics with infra, emma to update figma copy. staging-bot: queue staging deploy? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

staging-bot: Deploy queued: branch playground/stream-controls -> staging at 2026-07-12 02:00 UTC

emma (Product): Thanks team. If no major a11y issues we can lock pattern and refine microcopy after pilot. :thumbsup:
